name: 纳米激素增伤
description: 每份纳米激素使造成的伤害+1，可叠加。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var piece = context.sourcePiece; if (!piece || !(context.damage > 0)) return { success: false }; var bonus = (piece.statusTags || []).filter(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'nano-boost'; }).reduce(function(sum, tag) { return sum + (tag.intensity == null ? 1 : tag.intensity); }, 0); if (!bonus) return { success: false }; context.damage += bonus; return { success: true, message: piece.name + '的纳米激素使伤害+' + bonus }; }
